notes: well_02 (blue) and well_03 (green) are the same tan tarp-roof well differing only by a tiny pennant and a trough; well_04 (gold) is an orange onion-style dome with a purple band (orange not gold, off-palette purple) and well_01 is a fully kingdom-red roof. The tan roofs read as draped cloth, not thatch, and 1642-1778 tris is near the 1800 cap for a simple well.
